# Keyboard shortcuts

| Keys | What they do |
|---|---|
| **Enter** | Send your question. |
| **`Ctrl+P`** | Open the command list. |
| **`Ctrl+,`** | Open Settings. |
| **Esc** | Close the window or list that is open. |
| **`Ctrl+C`** | Copy the selected text. |
| **`Ctrl+X`** / **`Ctrl+V`** | Cut / paste in the question box. |
| **`Ctrl+A`** | Select everything in the question box. |
| **`Ctrl+Shift+A`** | Select the whole conversation. |

## Useful commands in the `Ctrl+P` list

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| **New thread** | Start a new conversation. |
| **Put this conversation in a project** | Move the current conversation into a project (its folder moves too). |
| **Save the latest report as a PDF** | Turn the latest report into a PDF with references, in the conversation's folder. |
| **Show this conversation's provenance** | See which specialists worked on this conversation. |
| **Expand agent activity** / **Collapse agent activity** | Show or hide the step-by-step details under every answer. |
| **Copy last answer** | Copy Mini-Me's latest answer. |
| **Run the named specialist in the background** | Type `/` and a specialist's name at the start of your question (for example `/report_writer …`), then run this command to send it as a background job without waiting. |
| **Restart the backend** | Fixes many "not responding" problems. |
| **Run setup checks** | Open the Get Started window again. |
| **Settings** | Open Settings. |
| **User manual** | Open this manual in your browser. |
| **About Mini-Me** | Opens **Settings → About**: version, data sources and how to cite. |
| **Quit** | Close Mini-Me. |
